output.reason: The proposed condition is wrong in two ways. It is too broad: it flags every VirtualService with a mirror, including sidecar-only meshes, but [ev-9aa6075f3dd7] says mirroring works with sidecars and fails only when the policy is applied to a waypoint. It is also too narrow: it misses Gateway API HTTPRoutes that use a RequestMirror filter, which is the reported case [ev-f1ecb696fc19], and its spec.tcp[].mirror leaf has no support in the evidence. A correct condition needs to say how a route is attached to a waypoint and which mirror forms the fix covers. Neither the one-line note [ev-9413f4b657a9] nor the truncated issue says this, and it is needed before a correction can be written without guessing.
